_comment: Colloquial tab behaviour knobs. The units and words are built in backend/data/colloquial/; this file is only how the tab shows them.
_comment-match-board: The most pairs one Match board shows. More words than this split into several evenly sized rounds.
_comment-least-under-heading: A heading in a word bank needs this many words; a smaller group joins the heading before it.
_comment-words-preview: How many of a phrase topic's words show before 'Show all': the full grid is several screens on a phone, and the conversation and practice below it are the topic's main work.
_comment-misses-before-shown: On a Picture board's Test, how many wrong taps on one word before its place is ringed for the learner.
_comment-feature-every: In a lesson's phrase mosaic, every this-many-th tile is drawn large, so the grid is not a wall of equal squares.
